scope: Exploratory stratified CPU panel; not full-validation metrics or an unbiased population estimate. No model, label, threshold, training state, or official result was modified. CPU and GPU field models both use FP32; cross-device roundoff was not measured.
selection: Two distinct-token scans per eligible donor x 10m median-range bin; one per sparse donor x bin; two per inserted-normal category x dominant 10m range bin; prefer distinct scenes; identity-hash ordering; each selected control paired to its original scan.
point_scores: points.npy: all actual returns in frames/start:stop order, including ignored context
